name: Technical Workshop
designSoul: Let every step reveal enough state that the audience can predict what comes next.

typography: monospace with readable sizing and line numbers only when referenced
decorationDNA: step markers, state chips, restrained connector paths
assetTreatment: annotate only the region being discussed and retain surrounding context
codeTreatment: show one teachable change at a time and keep previous state distinguishable without color alone

motion.signatureMove: The current step advances while the resulting state settles beside it.
motion.interruption: Input immediately lands on the requested stable teaching state.
motion.cleanup: Repeated next/back navigation never accumulates controllers, listeners, or timers.
motion.reducedEndpoint: Step and resulting state change together with a visible label and no travel.

landscape: pair instruction and state side by side
portrait: place the step objective above the state
use discrete cards instead of an overlong column
keep the active state in the first viewport
stacking: repeat critical labels near the state they describe
focalPoint: the active state is always the focal point
move annotations rather than crossing unrelated regions
prohibitedBehavior: scaling a full desktop capture into portrait
hiding a required step below the fold
using color as the only state indicator

qa: read every code sample at full portrait size
